SoldierRecommendBuilds.1.1: [3 New Star, 4 Dead Shot] New Star Guild: Balanced and All-Rounded
SoldierRecommendBuilds.1.2: Noya stacks Daisy effect. Paired with Dead Shot's Crit buffs and Divine Favor's effects, it's a balanced build.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.10.1: White Cat Troupe: 8 Suppressive Fire] Suppressive Fire Extreme Attack Speed
SoldierRecommendBuilds.10.2: In the early stage, center the strategy around Kasimira and continuously stack Attack Speed through high-frequency Auto Attacks. Chaton Evil Eye Unleashed can maximize Auto Attack bonuses.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.2.1: [6 Ashwind Club, 4 Suppressive Fire] Ashwind Club Besiege Build
SoldierRecommendBuilds.2.2: Ashwind members stack Besieged marks to enhance Auto Attacks and Energy Regen. Paired with Suppressive Fire to increase Attack Speed, this is an Auto Attack-focused, steamrolling lineup.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.3.2: Rush levels early to find Sherlock. After the frontline falls, Sherlock subbing in can inherit Forest Friends' high stats. Level 7 Forest Friends' Energy Regen amplifies this single-core burst build.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.4.1: [5 Grace Imperium, 4 Divine Favor] Grace Imperium DoT Burst
SoldierRecommendBuilds.4.2: Led by Canace, this build uses Grace Marks to inflict continuous HP loss, then detonates 5 stacks for a tenfold burst. Supplemented by Divine Favor and Charm control, it delivers top-tier damage.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.5.1: [6 United Harvest, 4 Charm Aura] United Harvest Economy Build
SoldierRecommendBuilds.5.2: United Harvest builds economy through loss streaks, grants extra gold at battle settlement, and stacks Performance to increase stats, using its resource advantage to crush the late game.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.6.1: [3 Petal Bloom, 6 Glamour Magic] Petal Bloom Double Cast
SoldierRecommendBuilds.6.2: Petal Bloom stacks extremely high Skill DMG bonuses, while Glamour Magic grants members repeated skill casts, allowing the team to deal astonishing damage in prolonged battles.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.7.1: [5 Desert Scorpion, 4 Apex Warrior] Sandscorpion Mercenary Summon Build
SoldierRecommendBuilds.7.2: Desert Golem supports the battle and improves overall combat strength. Use Apex Warrior for a stable transition, and finding Commander Hazana can greatly increase the team's power.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.8.1: [3 Chivalry, 4 Imperial Guard] Firstlight Noya Balanced
SoldierRecommendBuilds.8.2: Firstlight Noya consumes Shield when casting skills to increase damage. Chivalric Spirit can generate large amounts of Shield, balancing both offense and survivability.
SoldierRecommendBuilds.9.1: [Ninja Legacy, 8 Dead Shot] Dead Shot Crit Build
SoldierRecommendBuilds.9.2: Dead Shot members gain high Crit Rate and Crit DMG, while the Legacy of Ninjutsu bond further strengthens Otoha and Nanoha, forming a burst-damage lineup.
